note: Gains locked in (compare.py): each workload must cost at most atMost times another of the same run, in the same unit. Measured on macOS (wall clock) when set: layout/5000/change 0.007 of layout/5000, frame/blink/400/drawn 0.21 of frame/400, frame/blink/400 0.46 of frame/400;, editor/type-100k 3.4 of editor/type-1k, editor/scroll-1m 1.0 of editor/scroll-10k, buffers/edit-1m 1.3 of buffers/edit-10k, search/capped 0.23 of search/word; forge/type 0.036, forge/switch-tab 0.037 and forge/palette 0.071 of forge/open; the limits leave room for runners and callgrind.

locks.name: layout/5000/change
locks.why: one changed panel lays out only what it moves, not the whole tree

locks.name: frame/blink/400/drawn
locks.why: a blinking caret redraws only its damage region

locks.name: frame/blink/400
locks.why: a frame where nothing but the caret changed reuses the cached draw list

locks.name: watch/100000/change
locks.why: one changed file in a watched 100,000-file folder updates one row, never a new listing (0.14 on macOS)

locks.name: editor/type-100k
locks.why: a key typed in a long file redraws only the visible lines: the file's length barely counts

locks.name: editor/scroll-1m
locks.why: a scrolled frame finds its rows by index, not by walking the lines above

locks.name: buffers/edit-1m
locks.why: an edit's dirty check compares sizes first and never copies the text: a million lines cost what ten thousand do

locks.name: search/capped
locks.why: a search that reaches its cap stops walking and reading the folder at once

locks.name: forge/type
locks.why: a character typed into Forge's editor updates what reads that file, not the workbench

locks.name: forge/switch-tab
locks.why: switching Forge's tab rebuilds one editor group, not the workbench

locks.name: forge/palette
locks.why: opening and filtering Forge's command palette builds the palette alone

locks.name: syntax/type-100k
locks.why: a keystroke in a 100,000-line file parses again only what it changed and highlights one screen
